playbook.label: Geddon lure.at
playbook.why: Geddon always runs (flags_extra 0x40): his 470 yd loop takes ~30 s and passes 4-30 yd from ten 3-4 elite packs; his clearest walk point is 32 yd from one. Timed pulls of the packs on his walk all failed (he is back in 10-20 s); this spot, where pack A stood (cleared), is 15-18 yd off his walk and 38 yd from the nearest live pack (Firewalker pack inside his north loop). 2026-11-04. The camp is searched around the lure (same level, in sight, a walk the boss can make).

playbook.label: Ragnaros summonAt

Rooted; Magma Blast when nobody is in melee range; Wrath of Ragnaros knocks melee back; submerges at 3 min with eight Sons of Flame for 90 s. After a wipe he resets in place (no new gossip). 2026-11-10.
